metadata.title: Deflection of the hypervelocity stars by the dance of the Milky Way and Large Magellanic Cloud

notes: No individual star meets the criteria. The paper analyzes a simulated, unlabelled population of hypervelocity stars rather than individual stars (e.g., T:p3-b6, T:p4-b19). S5-HVS1 (T:p1-b9, T:p1-b11), HE 0437-5439 (T:p3-b1), and the Brown et al. (2005) object (T:p1-b9) are introductory literature examples rather than targets selected or followed up in this analysis.
